canonical_project: TeleYemen Sana'a international gateway / HQ (26-Sept, Al-Tahreer)
notes: Control side: building in Ansar Allah-held Sana'a; TeleYemen itself is a dual-authority entity (HQ Sana'a, IRG branch in Aden). TeleYemen HQ/international gateway housed telco equipment, servers, hosting and data services (Sana'a Center policy paper Jan 2021); DCD reported the building destroyed by a Saudi-led coalition airstrike Feb 2022, with TeleYemen saying it would resume services. Current status unverified -> unknown. Not commercial colocation; capacity null.
